1.Note: #97 leads the field to green on the inside, #71 outside.  #97 clears for the lead on the frontstretch, #2 looks inside #71 for 2nd in turn 1 but #71 clears for the spot by turn 2.

3.Note: #1 looks inside #2 for 3rd entering turn 1.   Both remain side-by-side until #1 clears for the spot entering the bus stop.  #88 looks inside #2 for 4th exiting the bus stop and completes the pass

5.Note: #97 and #71 have pulled away from the field, running 4.2 seconds ahead of #88, who just passed for 3rd

8.Note: #47 goes off track in the bus stop from 31st but continues

11.Note: #97 has extended his lead to 3.109 seconds over #71

18.Note: #97 (1st) pits.  #1 now leads.  14 cars in total did not flip the stage

19.Note: #97 cycles to 8th after his stop.  #22 closely hounds #1 for the lead

25.Note: Restart:  #97 leads from the inside, #71 outside.  #97 clears for the lead on the frontstretch, #71 slots into 2nd and #88 clears for 3rd.

27.Note: #88 gets by #71 for 2nd and begins to chase down #97

34.Note: #97 and #88 have pulled out to a 2.9 second lead over #71 in 3rd

40.Note: Caution:  Debris (tent on track) in turn 4

41.Note: All lead lap cars except #71 (3rd), #7 (7th), #20, #23, #35, #42 pit.  #97 gets off pit road first followed by #88 and #54

44.Note: Restart: #71 leads from the inside, #7 outside.  #71 clears for the lead by the frontstretch.  #35 spins in turn 1.  #24 spins in the bus stop after contact with #17 and gets hit by #12.  #34 also spins but all continue.

47.Note: #97 passes #71 for the lead in the bus stop.  #45 passes #71 for 2nd in turn 6.  #42, #21, #10, #34 all pit

55.Note: Restart:  #97 leads from the inside, #45 outside.  #97 clears for the lead on the frontstretch.  #54 clears #3 for 3rd.

57.Note: #97, #45 and #54 run within 0.8 seconds of each other at the front

60.Note: #22 goes off track in turn 1 from 34th and has a flat left front tire.  Caution waves for debris

61.Note: All lead lap cars except #97 (1st), #45 (2nd), #16 (15th), #23, #71, #41, #21, #7.  #54 gets off pit road first followed by #3 and #88.  #35 too fast entering

64.Note: Restart: #97 leads from the outside, #45 inside.  #97 clears for the lead exiting turn 1.

66.Note: #54 is the highest running car of those that pitted at the last caution, currently 7th

68.Note: #71 passes #45 for 3rd entering the bus stop.  #97 leads #16 by 3.64 seconds

71.Note: #78 spins from 34th after contact with #66 in the bus stop but slowly continues.  #45 pits from 6th

74.Note: #97 leads by 5.061 seconds over #71 but still needs to pit.  #54 moves to 3rd in the bus stop passing #16

76.Note: #97 pits from the lead.  #54 now leads.  #42, #9, #48 also pit

77.Note: #12 pits.  #54 told he is a half a lap short on fuel

82.Note: #54 leads #88 by 0.617 seconds.  #97 runs 12th, 21.983 seconds behind

86.Note: #23 spins from 17th after contact with #42 in turn 1 but continues

88.Note: #88 continues to hound #54 for the lead, #97 runs in 7th, 12 seconds behind

90.Note: #21, #51 spin exiting turn 6 but both continue.  #88 looks inside #54 in the bus stop but can't complete the pass.  #97 runs in 5th, 4.911 seconds behind

92.Note: #97 passes #88 for 2nd in the carousel and runs 1.5 seconds behind #54.  #88 pits with a flat right front tire.  #1 also pits

93.Note: #97 passes #54 entering the bus stop for the lead.  #71 passes #19 to move to 3rd

94.Note: #97 has extended his lead to 3.822 seconds over #54

97.Note: #97 has extended his lead to 6.895 seconds over #71

100.Note: #97 wins by 7.288 seconds over #71, the 4th largest margin of victory in Watkins Glen Cup history.  #21 spins in turn 1 but continues.
